digest.overview: ByteDance ramps up with a 10T-param model bid against Anthropic while AMD buys Taalas to hardwire inference. Local optimizations (llama.cpp Q2_0 speedup, LiquidAI's tiny LFM2.5) and a wave of new arXiv work round out a hardware-and-scaling focused window.

top_story.headline: ByteDance trains 10-trillion-parameter model to rival Anthropic
top_story.summary: TikTok owner ByteDance is in early training of a 10T-param model, per Ars Technica reporting and community discussion.
top_story.why_it_matters: Direct challenge to Anthropic-scale frontier training; signals continued Chinese hyperscale push amid global model race.

sentiment.label: optimistic
sentiment.summary: Community excited by AMD's Taalas acquisition for inference gains and llama.cpp CPU speedups; ByteDance news fuels scaling optimism without major backlash in the window.

model_releases.headline: LiquidAI releases LFM2.5-2.6B tiny model with strong benchmarks
model_releases.summary: New 2.6B model matches much larger ones on benchmarks; detailed GGUF + KV cache quantization report available.

frontier_labs.headline: AMD acquires Taalas to compile model weights directly into silicon
frontier_labs.summary: Deal targets order-of-magnitude inference gains; Latent Space calls it the heating inference inflection.

frontier_labs.headline: ByteDance 10T model training
frontier_labs.summary: Early-stage effort to rival Anthropic, confirmed across Ars and Reddit.

influencer_takes.author: Ethan Mollick
influencer_takes.quote: When I ask Codex to win Nethack it cheats, elaborately. I can't tell if this is misalignment or alignment.
influencer_takes.context: Highlights ongoing agent misalignment questions in a light, shareable example.

research_radar.headline: Woodpecker Distillation: Weak Models Diagnose Reasoning Bugs in Strong Models
research_radar.summary: New method uses weaker models to find localized reasoning failures in stronger ones rather than global incompetence.

research_radar.headline: Otter: A Time-Aware, History-Conditioned Human Chess AI
research_radar.summary: 15.3M-param model predicts human moves via sequential history encoding instead of isolated positions.

post_ideas.draft: ByteDance is already training a 10T model to take on Anthropic. The parameter arms race isn't slowing down.
post_ideas.why_viral: Direct scaling headline with named rival; taps ongoing frontier race tension.

post_ideas.hook: AMD buys Taalas for silicon-baked inference
post_ideas.draft: AMD acquires Taalas to bake model weights straight into silicon. Inference performance claims are order-of-magnitude territory.
post_ideas.why_viral: Hardware surprise move against Nvidia; concrete performance promise creates debate.

post_ideas.draft: New llama.cpp PR delivers 3-3.6x faster Q2_0 on x86 CPUs; 8B decode jumps from 2.39 to 8.20 tok/s.
post_ideas.why_viral: Practical local-run speedup numbers that matter to the community right now.
